set.body: Canonical pre-publication acceptance is rel-audit, absorbing foundation M6 and the ms-v10 alias. Resolve/document the supported all-module Scaladoc runtime (bd-01M3EE1CZ6B7VE87N1HVK9MK5C); audit PRD A-1..A-27 and foundation criteria on the release candidate. Then rel-publish publishes JVM+Scala.js and verifies independent consumers against Central, including A-16 publication evidence; rel-mima records the published policy and usable first-release baseline. Exit: all four tickets closed. Existing v-asc-e2e evidence satisfies its bounded A-11 workflow; unknown converter/EDF fields remain explicit and broader EyeLink certification stays post-v1.
set.title: 1.0 D: library acceptance and publication
